_meta.note: Canonical, approved copy for the Cunning Corp brand ladder. Do not edit casually — bump version on change. Human-readable mirror: Brand Ladder.dc.html. v1.3 adds aubreyNorthLexicon (approved AN content coinages).

voice.register: Sharp and witty — but dry, never zany.
voice.principle: Warm and whimsical, but never too poetic — copy must always paint a clear picture of what we do as a business.
rules: Wit is a scalpel: one clever turn per piece, maximum.
Confidence, no hype: no exclamation marks, no 'revolutionary'. State it plainly and let the bulb glow.
The 1/8th principle: show the one lit idea; never list every venture.
Volume is set per division: Ideas loudest, Publications & Productions measured, Aubrey North quietest.

aubreyNorthLexicon._note: Approved Aubrey North content coinages — the named ideas allowed to appear publicly on aubreynorth.com (in Reads, headings, microcopy). Editorial/craft terms, distinct from the brand-ladder positioning below. All obey voice.rules. This is the single source of truth for these terms; do not redefine them elsewhere.

terms.gloss: Refusing to tie a story off in a neat bow — the point where it starts to feel contrived. Aubrey North opposes it.
Character plus motive: the thing an audience invests in, the thing the character wants but never quite gets. No core, no reason for the idea to exist.
A defined, small world has depth. To the audience it must seem large; to the maker, only a few grand things can truly happen.
terms.note: Public name set from an internal working title (prefix dropped). Confirm 'The Boundary' as final.
